SELECT product_id,quantity,reason FROM disposal_items WHERE disposal_id=#{id} ORDER BY product_id

mapper.update: UPDATE disposals SET status=#{status},version=version+1,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status='PENDING'
